steps: Tell them not to move.
Kneel behind their head and hold it still with your hands on both sides, keeping the head, neck and body in a straight line.
Keep holding until the paramedics take over. Ask someone else to keep them warm.
Keep checking their breathing. If they stop breathing normally, start CPR.
If you must turn them, for example because they are vomiting, roll them with helpers, keeping the head, neck and body in line.
avoid: Do not move them unless they are in danger.
Do not let them sit up or turn their head.
en.intro: Suspect a neck or back injury after a fall from a height, a hard blow to the head, a road accident, or if they have neck or back pain, tingling, numbness or weakness in the arms or legs.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 now.
en.after: Tell the paramedics how the injury happened and whether they could move their arms and legs.

steps: Mwambie asisogee.
Piga magoti nyuma ya kichwa chake na ukishike kimya kwa mikono pande zote mbili, ukiweka kichwa, shingo na mwili katika mstari mmoja.
Endelea kushika mpaka wahudumu wa afya wachukue nafasi. Mwombe mtu mwingine amfunike apate joto.
Endelea kuangalia anavyopumua. Akiacha kupumua kawaida, anza CPR.
Kama lazima umgeuze, kwa mfano kwa sababu anatapika, mgeuze pamoja na wasaidizi, ukiweka kichwa, shingo na mwili katika mstari mmoja.
avoid: Usimsogeze isipokuwa yuko hatarini.
Usimwache akae wala ageuze kichwa.
sw.intro: Shuku jeraha la shingo au mgongo baada ya kuanguka kutoka juu, pigo kubwa kichwani, ajali ya barabarani, au kama ana maumivu ya shingo au mgongo, kuwashwa, kufa ganzi au udhaifu mikononi au miguuni.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 sasa hivi.
sw.after: Waambie wahudumu wa afya jinsi jeraha lilivyotokea na kama aliweza kusogeza mikono na miguu.

examples: he cut his finger while cooking
how to clean a small cut
the wound looks red and has pus
how do i dress a wound
kidonda kina usaha na kimekuwa chekundu

steps: Wash your hands, and wear gloves if you have them.
Stop any bleeding by pressing on it with a clean cloth for a few minutes.
Rinse the wound under clean running water to wash out dirt.
Gently clean around it and pat dry with something clean.
Cover it with a sterile plaster or dressing.
Change the dressing every day or when it gets wet or dirty, and check for infection.
avoid: Do not put cotton wool directly on the wound, fibres stick.
Do not pour spirit, bleach or other harsh chemicals into the wound.
en.intro: Small cuts and grazes usually heal well if they are cleaned and covered.
en.after: See a nurse or doctor if the cut is deep or gaping, keeps bleeding after 10 minutes of pressure, was made by something dirty or rusty or a bite, or shows infection: spreading redness, heat, swelling, pus or fever. People with diabetes should have any foot wound checked.

steps: Nawa mikono, na uvae glavu kama unazo.
Simamisha damu kwa kubonyeza kwa kitambaa safi kwa dakika chache.
Suuza jeraha chini ya maji safi yanayotiririka kuondoa uchafu.
Safisha kuzunguka kwa upole na ukaushe kwa kitu safi.
Lifunike kwa plasta au bendeji safi.
Badilisha bendeji kila siku au ikilowa au kuchafuka, na uangalie dalili za maambukizi.
avoid: Usiweke pamba moja kwa moja kwenye jeraha, nyuzi hushikamana.
Usimwage spiriti, jiki wala kemikali kali nyingine ndani ya jeraha.
sw.intro: Majeraha madogo na michubuko kwa kawaida hupona vizuri yakisafishwa na kufunikwa.
sw.after: Mwone muuguzi au daktari kama jeraha ni refu au liko wazi, linaendelea kuvuja damu baada ya dakika 10 za kubonyeza, lilisababishwa na kitu kichafu au chenye kutu au kuumwa, au lina dalili za maambukizi: wekundu unaoenea, joto, uvimbe, usaha au homa. Watu wenye kisukari wakaguliwe jeraha lolote la mguu.

title.sw: Jeraha dogo au mchubuko wa ngozi

examples: her skin tore when i moved her arm
he has a skin flap on his shin
thin skin tear on the arm what do i do
the skin peeled off when she bumped the bed

steps: Stop the bleeding with gentle pressure using a clean cloth.
Rinse with clean water or saline and let it air dry or pat very gently.
If there is a flap of skin, ease it gently back into place with a damp cotton bud or gloved finger.
Cover it with a non-stick dressing and hold it with a bandage, not tape on the skin.
Draw an arrow on the dressing showing which way to peel it off, in the direction of the flap, so it is not torn again.
avoid: Do not stick tape or plasters directly on fragile skin.
Do not rub or pull at the skin.
en.intro: Older people's skin is thin and can tear with a small knock. A skin tear heals best if the flap is saved.
en.after: Ask a nurse to check it, and pad furniture edges and keep the skin moisturised to prevent more tears.

steps: Simamisha damu kwa kubonyeza polepole kwa kitambaa safi.
Suuza kwa maji safi au maji ya chumvi (saline) na uache ikauke au uifute polepole sana.
Kama kuna kipande cha ngozi, kirudishe mahali pake polepole kwa pamba yenye unyevu au kidole chenye glavu.
Kifunike kwa bendeji isiyoshika jeraha na uishikilie kwa bendeji ya kuzungusha, si plasta kwenye ngozi.
Chora mshale kwenye bendeji kuonyesha upande wa kuiondoa, kufuata kipande cha ngozi, ili isichanike tena.
avoid: Usibandike plasta moja kwa moja kwenye ngozi nyembamba.
Usisugue wala kuvuta ngozi.
sw.intro: Ngozi ya wazee ni nyembamba na inaweza kuchanika kwa mgongano mdogo. Ngozi iliyochanika hupona vizuri kipande kikihifadhiwa.
sw.after: Mwombe muuguzi aikague, na ufunike kingo za samani na upake mafuta ngozi ili kuzuia kuchanika tena.

examples: she has had a nosebleed for 10 minutes
should i tilt the head back for a nose bleed

steps: Sit them down and lean them forward, not back.
Pinch the soft part of the nose, just below the bony bridge, firmly for 10 to 15 minutes without letting go.
Ask them to breathe through the mouth and spit out any blood.
A cold cloth on the bridge of the nose can help.
When it stops, they should rest and avoid blowing the nose, bending down or lifting heavy things for 24 hours.
avoid: Do not tilt the head back, blood runs down the throat and can cause vomiting or choking.
Do not let them lie down.
en.intro: Most nosebleeds can be stopped at home.
en.after: Get medical help if it lasts more than 20 minutes, is very heavy, followed a head injury, or they take blood thinners and it will not stop.

steps: Mkalishe na umwinamishe mbele, si nyuma.
Bana sehemu laini ya pua, chini kidogo ya mfupa, kwa nguvu kwa dakika 10 hadi 15 bila kuachia.
Mwambie apumue kwa mdomo na ateme damu yoyote.
Kitambaa baridi juu ya pua kinaweza kusaidia.
Ikisimama, apumzike na asipenge pua, kuinama au kubeba vitu vizito kwa saa 24.
avoid: Usimrudishe kichwa nyuma, damu huingia kooni na inaweza kusababisha kutapika au kukabwa.
Usimwache alale chini.
sw.intro: Damu nyingi za puani zinaweza kusimamishwa nyumbani.
sw.after: Tafuta msaada wa matibabu kama inachukua zaidi ya dakika 20, ni nyingi sana, ilitokea baada ya kuumia kichwa, au anatumia dawa za kupunguza kuganda kwa damu na haisimami.

examples: she burnt her hand on the stove
he spilled boiling water on his leg
what to do for a burn
should i put toothpaste on a burn
there is a blister after the burn
grandma burned herself on the jiko
how long should i cool a burn
ameungua na maji ya moto mguuni
nipake dawa ya meno kwenye jeraha la moto

steps: Move them away from the heat source.
Cool the burn under cool running water for 20 minutes. This still helps up to 3 hours after the burn.
Take off rings, watches and clothing near the burn, unless they are stuck to the skin.
After cooling, cover it loosely with cling film or a clean non-fluffy cloth.
Keep the rest of the body warm with a blanket, older people get cold quickly.
For chemical burns, brush off any dry powder, then rinse with lots of water for at least 20 minutes.
Paracetamol can help with pain if it is safe for them.
avoid: Do not use ice, butter, oil, toothpaste, flour, eggs or creams.
Do not burst blisters.
Do not remove clothing stuck to the burn.
en.intro: Cooling a burn quickly with water reduces the damage. Older people's skin burns more deeply.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 or go to hospital if the burn is bigger than the person's hand, is on the face, hands, feet, genitals or a joint, looks white, leathery or charred, was caused by electricity or chemicals, or they breathed in smoke.
en.after: See a nurse or doctor if the burn blisters, is larger than a coin, or shows infection later.

steps: Mwondoe karibu na chanzo cha joto.
Poza jeraha chini ya maji baridi yanayotiririka kwa dakika 20. Hii bado inasaidia hadi saa 3 baada ya kuungua.
Vua pete, saa na nguo karibu na jeraha, isipokuwa kama zimeshikamana na ngozi.
Baada ya kupoza, lifunike kwa ulegevu kwa karatasi ya plastiki ya jikoni au kitambaa safi kisicho na manyoya.
Mfunike mwili uliobaki kwa blanketi apate joto, wazee hupata baridi haraka.
Kwa kuungua na kemikali, futa unga wowote mkavu, kisha suuza kwa maji mengi kwa angalau dakika 20.
Paracetamol inaweza kusaidia maumivu kama ni salama kwake.
avoid: Usitumie barafu, siagi, mafuta, dawa ya meno, unga, mayai wala krimu.
Usipasue malengelenge.
Usiondoe nguo zilizoshikamana na jeraha.
sw.intro: Kupoza jeraha la moto haraka kwa maji kunapunguza madhara. Ngozi ya wazee huungua kwa kina zaidi.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 au nenda hospitali kama jeraha ni kubwa kuliko kiganja cha mtu, liko usoni, mikononi, miguuni, sehemu za siri au kwenye kiungo, linaonekana jeupe, gumu kama ngozi kavu au limeungua kuwa jeusi, lilisababishwa na umeme au kemikali, au alivuta moshi.
sw.after: Mwone muuguzi au daktari kama jeraha lina malengelenge, ni kubwa kuliko sarafu, au linaonyesha maambukizi baadaye.

ask.en: Is the burn bigger than their hand, deep, or on the face, hands, feet or genitals?
ask.sw: Je, jeraha ni kubwa kuliko kiganja chake, lina kina, au liko usoni, mikononi, miguuni au sehemu za siri?

title.sw: Kuungua na moto au maji ya moto

examples: dust in the eye how to remove
he got hit in the eye
her eye is red and painful after cleaning

steps: For a chemical splash: hold the eye open under gently running lukewarm water for at least 20 minutes, with the injured eye lower so water runs away from the other eye. Remove contact lenses if they come out easily.
For dust or grit: ask them to blink, then rinse the eye with clean water.
If something is stuck in the eye, do not remove it. Cover the eye with a clean paper cup or pad without pressing, and go to hospital.
For a blow to the eye, hold a cold cloth gently on it for 15 minutes.
avoid: Do not let them rub the eye.
Do not try to remove anything stuck in the eye.
en.intro: Eyes are delicate. Rinse anything chemical out straight away and do not rub.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 or go to hospital for chemicals in the eye, anything stuck in the eye, a cut to the eye, or sudden loss of vision.
en.after: See a doctor if pain, redness, blurred vision or light sensitivity continues.

steps: Kwa kemikali iliyorukia jichoni: shikilia jicho wazi chini ya maji ya uvuguvugu yanayotiririka polepole kwa angalau dakika 20, jicho lililoumia likiwa chini ili maji yasiingie jicho jingine. Toa lenzi za macho kama zinatoka kwa urahisi.
Kwa vumbi au mchanga: mwambie apepese, kisha suuza jicho kwa maji safi.
Kama kitu kimekwama jichoni, usikitoe. Funika jicho kwa kikombe safi cha karatasi au pedi bila kubonyeza, na uende hospitali.
Kwa pigo jichoni, shikilia kitambaa baridi juu yake polepole kwa dakika 15.
avoid: Usimwache asugue jicho.
Usijaribu kutoa kitu kilichokwama jichoni.
sw.intro: Macho ni dhaifu. Suuza kemikali yoyote mara moja na usisugue.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 au nenda hospitali kwa kemikali jichoni, kitu kilichokwama jichoni, jeraha la jicho, au kupoteza uwezo wa kuona ghafla.
sw.after: Mwone daktari kama maumivu, wekundu, kuona ukungu au kuumizwa na mwanga kunaendelea.

examples: he was bitten by a dog
cat scratched her and it is bleeding
do i need a rabies injection after a dog bite

steps: Wash the wound straight away with soap and plenty of running water for 15 minutes. This greatly lowers the rabies risk.
If you have an antiseptic such as povidone-iodine, apply it after washing.
Cover it with a clean dressing.
Go to a hospital or clinic the same day for rabies vaccine and a tetanus check, even if the wound is small.
Find out whose animal it was and whether it is vaccinated, and tell the clinic.
avoid: Do not close the wound tightly or stitch it at home.
Do not wait to see if the animal gets sick before getting the vaccine.
en.intro: Animal bites can carry infection and, in Kenya, rabies, which is deadly once symptoms start but can be prevented with vaccine.
en.urgent: If the bleeding is heavy, press on it and call 999 or 112.
en.after: Watch for redness, swelling, pus or fever over the next days and return to the clinic if you see them.

steps: Osha jeraha mara moja kwa sabuni na maji mengi yanayotiririka kwa dakika 15. Hii inapunguza sana hatari ya kichaa cha mbwa.
Kama una dawa ya kuua vijidudu kama povidone-iodine, ipake baada ya kuosha.
Lifunike kwa kitambaa safi.
Nenda hospitali au kliniki siku hiyo hiyo kwa chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa na kuangaliwa pepopunda, hata kama jeraha ni dogo.
Tafuta mnyama ni wa nani na kama amechanjwa, uiambie kliniki.
avoid: Usifunge jeraha kwa nguvu wala kulishona nyumbani.
Usisubiri kuona kama mnyama ataugua kabla ya kupata chanjo.
sw.intro: Kuumwa na wanyama kunaweza kuleta maambukizi na, nchini Kenya, kichaa cha mbwa, ambacho huua dalili zikianza lakini kinaweza kuzuiwa kwa chanjo.
sw.urgent: Kama damu ni nyingi, bonyeza jeraha na upige 999 au 112.
sw.after: Angalia wekundu, uvimbe, usaha au homa kwa siku zinazofuata na urudi kliniki ukiziona.

title.en: Dog, cat or other animal bite
title.sw: Kuumwa na mbwa, paka au mnyama mwingine

examples: he was bitten by a snake
a snake bit her on the leg in the garden
what to do for a snake bite
should i suck out the snake venom
spitting cobra spat in his eyes
nifanye nini mtu akiumwa na nyoka
nifunge kamba juu ya jeraha la nyoka

steps: Move away from the snake.
Keep the person calm, lying down and as still as possible, movement spreads venom.
Remove rings, watches, bangles and tight clothing near the bite before swelling starts.
Keep the bitten limb still, for example with a splint, and at or slightly below heart level.
Note the time of the bite and what the snake looked like. Take a photo only from a safe distance.
If a spitting cobra sprayed venom in the eyes, rinse them with lots of clean water.
If they stop breathing normally, start CPR.
avoid: Do not cut the bite, suck out venom, tie a tight tourniquet, put ice on it or use traditional remedies or black stones.
Do not give alcohol.
Do not try to catch or kill the snake.
en.intro: Snake bites in Kenya can be dangerous. Stay calm, keep still, and get to hospital fast, antivenom is given there.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 or take them to the nearest hospital now.
en.after: Even if the person feels fine, they must be seen at hospital, because some venoms act hours later.

steps: Ondokeni mbali na nyoka.
Mtulize mtu, alale chini na atulie kadri inavyowezekana, kusogea husambaza sumu.
Vua pete, saa, bangili na nguo zinazobana karibu na jeraha kabla uvimbe haujaanza.
Mwache kiungo kilichoumwa kitulie, kwa mfano kwa banzi, na kiwe usawa wa moyo au chini kidogo.
Andika saa aliyoumwa na jinsi nyoka alivyoonekana. Piga picha tu ukiwa mbali salama.
Kama swila amemtemea sumu machoni, yasuuze kwa maji mengi safi.
Akiacha kupumua kawaida, anza CPR.
avoid: Usikate jeraha, kunyonya sumu, kufunga kamba kwa nguvu, kuweka barafu wala kutumia dawa za kienyeji au jiwe jeusi.
Usimpe pombe.
Usijaribu kumkamata wala kumuua nyoka.
sw.intro: Kuumwa na nyoka nchini Kenya kunaweza kuwa hatari. Tulia, mwache atulie, na mfike hospitali haraka, dawa ya sumu (antivenom) hutolewa huko.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 au mpeleke hospitali iliyo karibu sasa hivi.
sw.after: Hata kama anajisikia mzima, lazima aonekane hospitali, kwa sababu sumu nyingine hufanya kazi saa kadhaa baadaye.

examples: she was stung by a bee
how to remove a bee sting
wasp sting on his arm is swollen
he was stung by a scorpion
jinsi ya kutoa mwiba wa nyuki

steps: If a bee sting is left in the skin, scrape it out sideways with a fingernail or a card as soon as possible.
Wash the area with soap and water.
Hold a cold pack wrapped in cloth on it for 10 to 20 minutes.
Raise the area if it is a hand, arm or leg.
An antihistamine tablet or paracetamol can help if they are safe for the person.
Watch them for an hour for signs of a severe allergic reaction.
avoid: Do not squeeze the sting with tweezers, it can push in more venom.
Do not scratch the area.
en.intro: Most stings cause pain, redness and swelling that settle in a day or two.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 if they have swelling of the face, lips or throat, difficulty breathing, feel faint, were stung in the mouth or throat, or were stung many times.
en.after: See a doctor if swelling keeps spreading after 2 days or there are signs of infection.

steps: Kama mwiba wa nyuki umebaki kwenye ngozi, ukwangue kwa pembeni kwa kucha au kadi haraka iwezekanavyo.
Osha sehemu hiyo kwa sabuni na maji.
Shikilia barafu iliyofungwa kwenye kitambaa juu yake kwa dakika 10 hadi 20.
Inua sehemu hiyo kama ni mkono au mguu.
Kidonge cha mzio (antihistamine) au paracetamol vinaweza kusaidia kama ni salama kwake.
Mwangalie kwa saa moja kwa dalili za mzio mkali.
avoid: Usiubane mwiba kwa koleo, inaweza kusukuma sumu zaidi.
Usikune sehemu hiyo.
sw.intro: Miuma mingi husababisha maumivu, wekundu na uvimbe ambao hupungua kwa siku moja au mbili.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 kama ana uvimbe usoni, midomoni au kooni, anapumua kwa shida, anahisi kuzimia, aliumwa mdomoni au kooni, au aliumwa mara nyingi.
sw.after: Mwone daktari kama uvimbe unaendelea kuenea baada ya siku 2 au kuna dalili za maambukizi.

examples: my diabetic patient is shaking and sweating
she is diabetic and suddenly confused
what do i give for low blood sugar
he took insulin and did not eat and now feels weak
mgonjwa wa kisukari anatetemeka na kutokwa jasho
bibi ana kisukari na amechanganyikiwa ghafla
amechoma insulini hajala na anajisikia dhaifu

steps: If they are awake and can swallow, sit them down.
Give fast sugar straight away: half a glass (150 ml) of fruit juice or a non-diet soda, or 3 to 4 teaspoons of sugar stirred into water, or glucose tablets.
Wait 10 to 15 minutes and check their sugar with their meter if they have one.
If they are not better 10 to 15 minutes after the first sugar, give fast sugar again and call 999 or 112.
Once they feel better, give a starchy snack or their next meal, such as bread, biscuits or ugali.
If they get worse at any point, call 999 or 112 straight away.
avoid: Do not give anything by mouth if they are drowsy or cannot swallow safely.
Do not give chocolate or fatty food as the first treatment, it works too slowly.
Do not leave them alone until they have recovered.
en.intro: People with diabetes who take insulin or diabetes tablets can have low blood sugar. Signs are shaking, sweating, paleness, hunger, a fast heartbeat, confusion, irritability, unusual behaviour or drowsiness.
en.urgent: If they are very drowsy, unconscious or cannot swallow safely, call 999 or 112, put them in the recovery position and give nothing by mouth.
en.after: Tell the family and their doctor, as their diabetes medicine or meals may need changing.

steps: Kama yuko macho na anaweza kumeza, mkalishe chini.
Mpe sukari ya haraka mara moja: nusu glasi (ml 150) ya juisi ya matunda au soda isiyo ya diet, au vijiko 3 hadi 4 vya sukari vilivyokorogwa kwenye maji, au vidonge vya glukosi.
Subiri dakika 10 hadi 15 na upime sukari kwa mashine yake kama anayo.
Kama hajapata nafuu dakika 10 hadi 15 baada ya sukari ya kwanza, mpe sukari ya haraka tena na upige 999 au 112.
Akijisikia vizuri, mpe chakula cha wanga au mlo wake unaofuata, kama mkate, biskuti au ugali.
Akizidi kuwa mbaya wakati wowote, piga 999 au 112 mara moja.
avoid: Usimpe chochote kwa mdomo kama anasinzia au hawezi kumeza salama.
Usimpe chokoleti au vyakula vya mafuta kama tiba ya kwanza, vinafanya kazi polepole sana.
Usimwache peke yake mpaka apone.
sw.intro: Watu wenye kisukari wanaotumia insulini au vidonge vya kisukari wanaweza kushukiwa na sukari. Dalili ni kutetemeka, kutokwa jasho, kupauka, njaa, moyo kwenda mbio, kuchanganyikiwa, hasira, tabia isiyo ya kawaida au kusinzia.
sw.urgent: Kama anasinzia sana, hajitambui au hawezi kumeza salama, piga 999 au 112, mlaze katika mkao wa kupona na usimpe chochote kwa mdomo.
sw.after: Iambie familia na daktari wake, kwani dawa zake za kisukari au milo inaweza kuhitaji kubadilishwa.

ask.en: Is the person awake and able to swallow?
ask.sw: Je, mtu huyo yuko macho na anaweza kumeza?

examples: diabetic very thirsty and urinating a lot
what to do when blood sugar is high
his breath smells fruity and he is vomiting
ana kiu sana na anakojoa mara kwa mara

steps: Check their sugar with their meter if they have one, and write down the reading and time.
Give plenty of water or other sugar-free drinks.
Help them follow their diabetes plan and take their usual medicine as prescribed.
Contact their doctor or clinic today for advice if the sugar stays high.
Recheck the sugar in 2 hours and watch for the danger signs above.
avoid: Do not give sugary drinks or sweets.
Do not skip or change their insulin or tablets unless the doctor says so.
en.intro: High blood sugar causes thirst, passing a lot of urine, tiredness, blurred vision and headaches. Very high sugar can become dangerous.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 or go to hospital if the meter reads "HI" or above about 16.7 mmol/L (300 mg/dL) and they are vomiting, very drowsy, confused, breathing fast and deep, or their breath smells fruity.
en.after: Share the readings with the family and the doctor so treatment can be adjusted.

steps: Pima sukari yake kwa mashine kama anayo, na uandike kipimo na saa.
Mpe maji mengi au vinywaji vingine visivyo na sukari.
Msaidie kufuata mpango wake wa kisukari na kutumia dawa zake za kawaida kama alivyoandikiwa.
Wasiliana na daktari au kliniki yake leo kwa ushauri kama sukari inabaki juu.
Pima tena sukari baada ya saa 2 na uangalie dalili za hatari hapo juu.
avoid: Usimpe vinywaji vyenye sukari wala peremende.
Usiruke wala kubadilisha insulini au vidonge vyake isipokuwa daktari akisema.
sw.intro: Sukari ikipanda husababisha kiu, kukojoa sana, uchovu, kuona ukungu na maumivu ya kichwa. Sukari iliyo juu sana inaweza kuwa hatari.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 au nenda hospitali kama mashine inasoma "HI" au juu ya takriban 16.7 mmol/L (300 mg/dL) na anatapika, anasinzia sana, amechanganyikiwa, anapumua haraka na kwa kina, au pumzi yake inanuka kama matunda.
sw.after: Shiriki vipimo na familia na daktari ili matibabu yarekebishwe.

examples: she is having an asthma attack
he is wheezing and can't catch his breath
how many puffs of the inhaler should i give
his chest is tight and he is wheezing

steps: Help them sit upright, leaning slightly forward. Keep calm and reassure them.
Help them use their reliever inhaler, usually blue (salbutamol): 1 puff every 30 to 60 seconds, up to 10 puffs. Use a spacer if they have one.
If they are not better after 10 puffs, or are getting worse, call 999 or 112.
If help has not arrived after 10 minutes, repeat up to 10 puffs.
avoid: Do not lie them down.
Do not leave them alone.
en.intro: In an asthma attack the airways tighten, causing wheezing, coughing, a tight chest and breathlessness.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 if they are too breathless to speak, their lips are turning blue, they are exhausted or drowsy, or the inhaler is not helping.
en.after: Even if the attack settles, they should see their doctor within 2 days to review their asthma treatment.

steps: Msaidie akae wima, ameinama mbele kidogo. Tulia na umtulize.
Msaidie atumie inhaler yake ya kupunguza pumu, kwa kawaida ya bluu (salbutamol): pafu 1 kila sekunde 30 hadi 60, hadi pafu 10. Tumia spacer kama anayo.
Kama hajapata nafuu baada ya pafu 10, au anazidi kuwa mbaya, piga 999 au 112.
Kama msaada haujafika baada ya dakika 10, rudia hadi pafu 10.
avoid: Usimlaze chini.
Usimwache peke yake.
sw.intro: Wakati wa shambulio la pumu njia za hewa hubana, na kusababisha mluzi, kikohozi, kifua kubana na kukosa pumzi.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 kama anakosa pumzi kiasi cha kushindwa kuongea, midomo inakuwa bluu, amechoka sana au anasinzia, au inhaler haisaidii.
sw.after: Hata shambulio likitulia, amwone daktari wake ndani ya siku 2 kukagua matibabu ya pumu.

examples: he has copd and is more breathless today

steps: Help them sit upright, leaning forward with arms resting on a table or their knees.
Loosen tight clothing and open a window for fresh air.
If they have a prescribed inhaler or home oxygen, help them use it as directed.
Encourage slow breathing: in through the nose, out slowly through pursed lips.
Stay with them and keep checking how they are breathing and how alert they are.
avoid: Do not lie them flat.
Do not allow smoking or open flames near home oxygen.
en.intro: Breathlessness in an older person can come from the lungs, the heart, an infection or anxiety. Sudden or severe breathlessness is an emergency.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 if it came on suddenly, is severe, they have chest pain, blue or grey lips, cannot finish a sentence, are confused or drowsy, or cannot lie flat when they normally can.
en.after: Tell their doctor today about any new or worsening breathlessness, even if it settles.

steps: Msaidie akae wima, ameinama mbele na mikono imeegemea meza au magoti.
Legeza nguo zinazobana na ufungue dirisha apate hewa safi.
Kama ana inhaler aliyoandikiwa au oksijeni ya nyumbani, msaidie aitumie kama alivyoelekezwa.
Mhimize apumue polepole: ndani kwa pua, nje polepole kwa midomo iliyobanwa.
Kaa naye na uendelee kuangalia anavyopumua na kama yuko macho.
avoid: Usimlaze chali.
Usiruhusu uvutaji sigara wala moto karibu na oksijeni ya nyumbani.
sw.intro: Kukosa pumzi kwa mzee kunaweza kutokana na mapafu, moyo, maambukizi au wasiwasi. Kukosa pumzi ghafla au kwa kiasi kikubwa ni dharura.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 kama kulianza ghafla, ni kukubwa, ana maumivu ya kifua, midomo ya bluu au kijivu, hawezi kumaliza sentensi, amechanganyikiwa au anasinzia, au hawezi kulala chali wakati kwa kawaida anaweza.
sw.after: Mwambie daktari wake leo kuhusu kukosa pumzi kupya au kunakozidi, hata kama kutatulia.

examples: grandma blacked out for a few seconds
what to do when someone faints
he passed out when he stood up
bibi amepoteza fahamu kwa sekunde chache

steps: If they feel faint, help them lie down, or sit with the head between the knees.
If they have fainted, lay them on their back and raise their legs about 30 cm on a chair or pillows.
Loosen tight clothing and let fresh air in.
When they wake, keep them lying down for a few minutes, then help them sit up slowly.
Give sips of water once they are fully awake.
If they stay unresponsive but are breathing, put them in the recovery position.
avoid: Do not sit them up or stand them up quickly.
Do not splash water on their face or give drinks while drowsy.
en.intro: Fainting is a short loss of consciousness when blood flow to the brain drops. People usually wake within a minute.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 if they do not wake within a minute, are injured, have chest pain, a racing or irregular heartbeat or breathlessness, fainted during activity, or it is the first time in an older person.
en.after: In older people fainting can be a sign of a heart problem, low blood pressure or a medicine side effect, so tell their doctor.

steps: Akihisi kuzirai, msaidie alale chini, au akae na kichwa kati ya magoti.
Kama amezirai, mlaze chali na uinue miguu yake kama sentimita 30 juu ya kiti au mito.
Legeza nguo zinazobana na uruhusu hewa safi.
Akizinduka, mwache alale kwa dakika chache, kisha msaidie akae polepole.
Mpe maji kidogo kidogo akishazinduka kabisa.
Kama anabaki bila kujitambua lakini anapumua, mlaze katika mkao wa kupona.
avoid: Usimkalishe wala kumsimamisha haraka.
Usimmwagie maji usoni wala kumpa vinywaji akiwa bado anasinzia.
sw.intro: Kuzirai ni kupoteza fahamu kwa muda mfupi mtiririko wa damu kwenye ubongo ukipungua. Kwa kawaida watu huzinduka ndani ya dakika moja.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 kama hazinduki ndani ya dakika moja, ameumia, ana maumivu ya kifua, moyo unakwenda mbio au bila mpangilio au anakosa pumzi, alizirai akifanya kazi, au ni mara ya kwanza kwa mzee.
sw.after: Kwa wazee kuzirai kunaweza kuwa ishara ya tatizo la moyo, shinikizo la chini la damu au madhara ya dawa, kwa hiyo mwambie daktari wake.

examples: what to do if someone swallowed poison
should i make him vomit after poisoning
they slept with a charcoal jiko in the room and feel dizzy
smell of fumes and grandma has a headache and is confused
he sprayed pesticide and is now vomiting
amekunywa mafuta ya taa kwa makosa
walilala na jiko la makaa chumbani
amevuta moshi wa makaa na ana kizunguzungu

steps: For fumes or smoke: get them into fresh air straight away, open doors and windows, and turn off or remove the jiko or heater, without putting yourself at risk.
Find out what they took or touched, how much and when. Keep the container, packet or plant to show the medics.
If they are unresponsive but breathing, put them in the recovery position. If they are not breathing normally, start CPR, using a face shield if the poison is on their mouth.
If a chemical is on the skin or in the eyes, rinse with lots of running water for 20 minutes and remove contaminated clothing.
If chemicals burned the lips, they can rinse their mouth and spit, without swallowing.
avoid: Do not make them vomit.
Do not give salt water, milk or oil. Only give drinks if a doctor or poison expert tells you to.
Never use a charcoal jiko indoors with doors and windows closed.
en.intro: Poisoning can come from swallowing chemicals, pesticides, too much medicine, poisonous plants, or breathing in fumes, such as from a charcoal jiko in a closed room.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 now.
en.after: Take the container or a photo of the label to hospital.

steps: Kwa moshi au gesi: mtoe nje kwenye hewa safi mara moja, fungua milango na madirisha, na uzime au uondoe jiko au hita, bila kujiweka hatarini.
Tafuta alichokunywa au kugusa, kiasi gani na lini. Hifadhi chombo, pakiti au mmea uwaonyeshe wahudumu wa afya.
Kama hajitambui lakini anapumua, mlaze katika mkao wa kupona. Kama hapumui kawaida, anza CPR, ukitumia kinga ya uso kama sumu iko mdomoni mwake.
Kama kemikali iko kwenye ngozi au machoni, suuza kwa maji mengi yanayotiririka kwa dakika 20 na uvue nguo zilizochafuka.
Kama kemikali ilichoma midomo, anaweza kusukutua mdomo na kutema, bila kumeza.
avoid: Usimfanye atapike.
Usimpe maji ya chumvi, maziwa wala mafuta. Mpe vinywaji tu daktari au mtaalamu wa sumu akisema.
Kamwe usitumie jiko la makaa ndani ya nyumba milango na madirisha yakiwa yamefungwa.
sw.intro: Sumu inaweza kutokana na kumeza kemikali, dawa za wadudu, dawa nyingi kupita kiasi, mimea yenye sumu, au kuvuta moshi, kama wa jiko la makaa ndani ya chumba kilichofungwa.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 sasa hivi.
sw.after: Peleka chombo au picha ya lebo hospitalini.

examples: she took her tablets twice today
i gave him the wrong pills
grandma swallowed the whole packet of tablets
what to do about a double dose of blood pressure medicine
he forgot his morning medicine should he take two now
amekunywa dawa zake mara mbili leo
amesahau dawa ya asubuhi anywe mbili sasa

steps: Stay calm and find out exactly which medicine, how much and when. Keep the packets and the medicine list.
Call their doctor, the clinic or a pharmacist now for advice, or 999 or 112 if you cannot reach them.
Watch them closely for the next hours for drowsiness, confusion, vomiting or changes in breathing.
If they become unresponsive but are breathing, put them in the recovery position.
For a missed dose: check the leaflet or ask the pharmacist. Usually you take it when remembered unless it is nearly time for the next dose.
avoid: Do not make them vomit.
Never give a double dose to make up for a missed one, unless a doctor tells you to.
en.intro: Taking a double dose, the wrong medicine or someone else's medicine is common with older people. Many mistakes are harmless, but some medicines are dangerous in extra doses.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 straight away if they are drowsy, confused, breathing slowly, have chest pain, a very slow or fast heartbeat, a seizure, or are unresponsive, or if they took a large amount on purpose.
en.after: A weekly pill organiser and a written medicine chart help prevent repeat mistakes. Tell the family about the mistake.

steps: Tulia na ujue hasa ni dawa gani, kiasi gani na lini. Hifadhi pakiti na orodha ya dawa.
Mpigie daktari wake, kliniki au mfamasia sasa kwa ushauri, au 999 au 112 kama huwapati.
Mwangalie kwa karibu kwa saa zinazofuata kwa kusinzia, kuchanganyikiwa, kutapika au mabadiliko ya kupumua.
Akiacha kujitambua lakini anapumua, mlaze katika mkao wa kupona.
Kwa dozi iliyosahaulika: angalia karatasi ya maelekezo au muulize mfamasia. Kwa kawaida inatumika ukikumbuka isipokuwa kama ni karibu na wakati wa dozi inayofuata.
avoid: Usimfanye atapike.
Kamwe usimpe dozi mara mbili kufidia iliyosahaulika, isipokuwa daktari akisema.
sw.intro: Kumeza dozi mara mbili, dawa isiyo sahihi au dawa ya mtu mwingine ni kawaida kwa wazee. Makosa mengi hayana madhara, lakini dawa nyingine ni hatari kwa dozi za ziada.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 mara moja kama anasinzia, amechanganyikiwa, anapumua polepole, ana maumivu ya kifua, mapigo ya moyo ni polepole sana au haraka sana, anapata kifafa, au hajitambui, au kama alimeza kiasi kikubwa kwa makusudi.
sw.after: Kisanduku cha vidonge cha wiki na chati ya dawa iliyoandikwa husaidia kuzuia makosa kujirudia. Iambie familia kuhusu kosa hilo.

title.sw: Dawa nyingi au dawa isiyo sahihi

examples: she is very hot and dizzy after sitting in the sun
amepigwa na jua na ana kizunguzungu

steps: Move them to a cool, shady place and help them lie down with legs slightly raised.
Remove extra clothing.
Cool the skin: spray or sponge with cool water and fan them. Cold packs wrapped in cloth in the armpits and neck help.
If they are alert, give sips of cool water or oral rehydration solution (ORS).
Keep cooling and watch them closely.
avoid: Do not give alcohol, coffee or very sugary drinks.
Do not give anything to drink if they are confused or drowsy.
en.intro: Older people overheat easily. Heat exhaustion causes headache, dizziness, heavy sweating, cramps, nausea and a fast pulse. Heatstroke is an emergency: hot skin, confusion, fits or unconsciousness.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 if they are confused, have a seizure, are unresponsive, have a very high temperature (40 °C or more), or do not improve within 30 minutes.
en.after: Keep them cool and drinking regularly on hot days, and check on them often.

steps: Mpeleke mahali penye baridi na kivuli na umsaidie alale na miguu imeinuliwa kidogo.
Mvue nguo za ziada.
Poza ngozi: mnyunyizie au mpanguse kwa maji baridi na umpepee. Barafu iliyofungwa kwenye kitambaa makwapani na shingoni husaidia.
Kama yuko macho, mpe maji baridi kidogo kidogo au mchanganyiko wa ORS.
Endelea kumpoza na umwangalie kwa karibu.
avoid: Usimpe pombe, kahawa wala vinywaji vyenye sukari nyingi.
Usimpe kinywaji chochote kama amechanganyikiwa au anasinzia.
sw.intro: Wazee hupata joto kupita kiasi kwa urahisi. Uchovu wa joto husababisha maumivu ya kichwa, kizunguzungu, jasho jingi, kukakamaa kwa misuli, kichefuchefu na mapigo ya haraka. Kiharusi cha joto ni dharura: ngozi ya moto, kuchanganyikiwa, kifafa au kupoteza fahamu.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 kama amechanganyikiwa, anapata kifafa, hajitambui, ana joto la juu sana (nyuzi 40 au zaidi), au hapati nafuu ndani ya dakika 30.
sw.after: Mweke mahali pa baridi na anywe maji mara kwa mara siku za joto, na umwangalie mara nyingi.

title.sw: Uchovu wa joto na kiharusi cha joto

examples: she is very cold and shivering
his hands and body are ice cold and he is confused
signs of hypothermia in the elderly
grandpa was outside in the cold night
mwili wake ni baridi sana na amechanganyikiwa

steps: Move them to a warm room, out of the wind.
Replace wet clothing with dry clothing.
Wrap them in blankets, including the head, and put a blanket underneath if they are on the floor.
If they are alert and can swallow, give warm sweet drinks and some food.
Warm the room, and stay with them until their temperature and alertness are back to normal.
avoid: Do not put them in a hot bath, or put hot water bottles or heaters directly against the skin.
Do not rub their arms and legs.
Do not give alcohol.
en.intro: Older people can get dangerously cold, even indoors on cold nights in the highlands. Signs are shivering, cold pale skin, slurred speech, confusion, clumsiness and drowsiness.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 if they are drowsy, confused, have stopped shivering while still cold, or are breathing slowly.
en.after: Make sure their room stays warm at night and they have enough bedding.

steps: Mpeleke kwenye chumba chenye joto, mbali na upepo.
Mbadilishe nguo zilizolowa kwa nguo kavu.
Mfunike kwa blanketi, pamoja na kichwa, na umwekee blanketi chini kama yuko sakafuni.
Kama yuko macho na anaweza kumeza, mpe vinywaji vya moto vyenye sukari na chakula kidogo.
Pasha chumba joto, na ukae naye mpaka joto lake na umakini wake urudi kawaida.
avoid: Usimweke kwenye maji ya moto ya kuoga, wala kuweka chupa za maji ya moto au hita moja kwa moja kwenye ngozi.
Usisugue mikono na miguu yake.
Usimpe pombe.
sw.intro: Wazee wanaweza kupata baridi hatari, hata ndani ya nyumba usiku wa baridi maeneo ya juu. Dalili ni kutetemeka, ngozi baridi nyeupe, maneno kutotoka vizuri, kuchanganyikiwa, kutokuwa makini na kusinzia.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 kama anasinzia, amechanganyikiwa, ameacha kutetemeka ingawa bado ni baridi, au anapumua polepole.
sw.after: Hakikisha chumba chake kinabaki na joto usiku na ana matandiko ya kutosha.

examples: she keeps vomiting and can't keep water down
signs of dehydration in the elderly
how to make ors at home
his urine is very dark and he is dizzy
grandma is not drinking water and is weak
anatapika na hawezi kubaki na maji
mkojo wake ni mweusi na ana kizunguzungu
dalili za upungufu wa maji mwilini

steps: Give oral rehydration solution (ORS): mix a sachet with clean water exactly as the packet says.
Give small sips often, for example a few sips every few minutes, even if they are vomiting.
If you have no ORS, mix 1 litre of clean, boiled and cooled water with 6 level teaspoons of sugar and half a level teaspoon of salt.
Keep offering light food once they can eat, such as porridge, rice or bananas.
Wash hands well with soap after helping them or changing them, to stop the infection spreading.
avoid: Do not use sodas or fruit juice as the main drink, they can make diarrhoea worse.
Do not give anti-diarrhoea medicine if there is blood in the stool or a fever, unless a doctor says so.
en.intro: Vomiting, diarrhoea, heat or not drinking enough can quickly dry out an older person. Signs are thirst, a dry mouth, dark or little urine, dizziness, tiredness and new confusion.
en.urgent: Get medical help today, or call 999 or 112, if they cannot keep fluids down, there is blood in the vomit or stool, no urine for 8 hours, they are very drowsy or confused, have severe belly pain, or the diarrhoea lasts more than 2 days.
en.after: Keep a note of how much they drink and pass urine, and tell the doctor if they take water tablets (diuretics) or diabetes medicine, which may need pausing.

steps: Mpe mchanganyiko wa ORS: changanya pakiti moja na maji safi kama pakiti inavyosema.
Mpe kidogo kidogo mara kwa mara, kwa mfano mafunda machache kila baada ya dakika chache, hata kama anatapika.
Kama huna ORS, changanya lita 1 ya maji safi yaliyochemshwa na kupozwa na vijiko 6 vya chai vya sukari visivyojaa na nusu kijiko cha chai cha chumvi.
Endelea kumpa chakula chepesi akiweza kula, kama uji, wali au ndizi.
Nawa mikono vizuri kwa sabuni baada ya kumsaidia au kumbadilisha, kuzuia maambukizi kuenea.
avoid: Usitumie soda wala juisi kama kinywaji kikuu, vinaweza kuzidisha kuhara.
Usimpe dawa ya kuzuia kuhara kama kuna damu kwenye kinyesi au homa, isipokuwa daktari akisema.
sw.intro: Kutapika, kuhara, joto au kutokunywa maji ya kutosha kunaweza kumkausha mzee haraka. Dalili ni kiu, mdomo mkavu, mkojo mweusi au kidogo, kizunguzungu, uchovu na kuchanganyikiwa kupya.
sw.urgent: Tafuta msaada wa matibabu leo, au piga 999 au 112, kama hawezi kubaki na vinywaji tumboni, kuna damu kwenye matapishi au kinyesi, hajakojoa kwa saa 8, anasinzia sana au amechanganyikiwa, ana maumivu makali ya tumbo, au kuhara kunaendelea zaidi ya siku 2.
sw.after: Andika kiasi anachokunywa na kukojoa, na umwambie daktari kama anatumia dawa za kukojoa au za kisukari, ambazo zinaweza kuhitaji kusimamishwa.

title.sw: Kutapika, kuhara na upungufu wa maji

examples: what to do for a fever in an old person
could it be malaria he has fever and headache
nadhani ni malaria ana homa na kichwa kinauma

steps: Measure the temperature with a thermometer and write it down with the time.
Keep them comfortable in light clothing in a cool, airy room.
Give plenty of fluids, little and often.
Paracetamol can bring the temperature down. Give the dose on the packet, only if it is safe with their other medicines, and do not exceed the daily maximum.
In Kenya, any fever should be tested for malaria within 24 hours at a clinic.
avoid: Do not use cold baths or ice to cool them.
Do not wrap them in heavy blankets.
Do not give more than one medicine that contains paracetamol at the same time.
en.intro: A temperature of 38 °C or more is a fever, usually caused by an infection. In older people an infection may show as confusion, weakness or falls instead of a high temperature.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 or go to hospital now if the fever comes with confusion or drowsiness, a stiff neck, a rash that does not fade when pressed with a glass, difficulty breathing, a seizure, very fast breathing or heartbeat, or a temperature of 40 °C or more.
en.after: Tell the family and get them seen at a clinic if the fever lasts more than 2 days or they seem more unwell.

steps: Pima joto kwa kipimajoto na uliandike pamoja na saa.
Mweke vizuri akiwa na nguo nyepesi katika chumba chenye hewa na baridi.
Mpe vinywaji vingi, kidogo kidogo mara kwa mara.
Paracetamol inaweza kushusha joto. Mpe dozi iliyoandikwa kwenye pakiti, kama tu ni salama pamoja na dawa zake nyingine, na usizidi kiasi cha juu cha siku.
Nchini Kenya, homa yoyote ipimwe malaria ndani ya saa 24 kliniki.
avoid: Usitumie maji baridi ya kuoga wala barafu kumpoza.
Usimfunike kwa blanketi nzito.
Usimpe dawa zaidi ya moja zenye paracetamol kwa wakati mmoja.
sw.intro: Joto la nyuzi 38 au zaidi ni homa, kwa kawaida husababishwa na maambukizi. Kwa wazee maambukizi yanaweza kuonekana kama kuchanganyikiwa, udhaifu au kuanguka badala ya joto la juu.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 au nenda hospitali sasa kama homa inakuja na kuchanganyikiwa au kusinzia, shingo kukakamaa, vipele visivyofifia vikibonyezwa na glasi, kupumua kwa shida, kifafa, kupumua au mapigo ya moyo ya haraka sana, au joto la nyuzi 40 au zaidi.
sw.after: Iambie familia na umpeleke kliniki kama homa inaendelea zaidi ya siku 2 au anaonekana kuzidiwa.

examples: she is talking nonsense since morning
my patient is disoriented and agitated
sudden change in behaviour in an old man

steps: Do the FAST stroke check first: face, arms, speech.
If they have diabetes, check their blood sugar if you can, and treat low sugar if it is low.
Check for fever, signs of dehydration, a recent fall, pain, or a new or missed medicine.
Keep them safe and calm: speak slowly and simply, keep the room quiet and well lit, and keep glasses and hearing aids on.
Call their doctor or clinic today and tell them what you found.
avoid: Do not argue with them or leave them alone.
Do not give sleeping tablets or sedatives.
en.intro: Sudden confusion in an older person (delirium) is a warning sign of illness, such as an infection, low blood sugar, dehydration, a stroke, a medicine problem or a head injury. It needs checking the same day.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 if there are stroke signs (face drooping, arm weakness, slurred speech), they are very drowsy or hard to wake, have a high fever, breathing problems, or hit their head.
en.after: Tell the family when the confusion started and how it changed. This is very useful for the doctor.

steps: Fanya kwanza kipimo cha kiharusi cha FAST: uso, mikono, kuongea.
Kama ana kisukari, pima sukari yake ukiweza, na utibu sukari iliyoshuka kama iko chini.
Angalia homa, dalili za upungufu wa maji, kuanguka hivi karibuni, maumivu, au dawa mpya au iliyosahaulika.
Mweke salama na mtulivu: ongea polepole na kwa urahisi, chumba kiwe kimya na chenye mwanga, na avae miwani na vifaa vya kusikia.
Mpigie daktari au kliniki yake leo na uwaambie ulichokiona.
avoid: Usibishane naye wala kumwacha peke yake.
Usimpe vidonge vya usingizi wala vya kutuliza.
sw.intro: Kuchanganyikiwa ghafla kwa mzee (delirium) ni ishara ya onyo ya ugonjwa, kama maambukizi, sukari kushuka, upungufu wa maji, kiharusi, tatizo la dawa au jeraha la kichwa. Inahitaji kuangaliwa siku hiyo hiyo.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 kama kuna dalili za kiharusi (uso kupinda, mkono kulegea, maneno kutotoka vizuri), anasinzia sana au ni vigumu kumwamsha, ana homa kali, matatizo ya kupumua, au aligonga kichwa.
sw.after: Iambie familia kuchanganyikiwa kulianza lini na kulivyobadilika. Hii inamsaidia sana daktari.

examples: his bp is very high today
what to do when blood pressure is high
should i give an extra blood pressure tablet
shinikizo la damu limepanda na kichwa kinauma
nimpe dawa ya ziada ya presha

steps: Have them sit quietly for 5 minutes with the back supported and feet flat.
Measure again with the arm resting at heart level, without talking. Write down both readings.
If it is still 180/120 or higher without symptoms, call their doctor or clinic today.
Make sure they took their usual blood pressure medicine as prescribed.
Keep them calm and recheck in 30 minutes.
avoid: Do not give extra doses of their medicine or someone else's medicine.
Do not let them do heavy activity until it is checked.
en.intro: One high reading is not always an emergency. What matters is how high it is and whether they have symptoms.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 if the reading is 180/120 or higher and they have chest pain, a severe headache, breathlessness, confusion, blurred vision, weakness or numbness, or trouble speaking.
en.after: Keep a record of readings to show their doctor.

steps: Mwache akae kimya kwa dakika 5 mgongo ukiwa umeegemea na nyayo sakafuni.
Pima tena mkono ukiwa umeegemea usawa wa moyo, bila kuongea. Andika vipimo vyote viwili.
Kama bado ni 180/120 au zaidi bila dalili, mpigie daktari au kliniki yake leo.
Hakikisha alitumia dawa zake za kawaida za shinikizo kama alivyoandikiwa.
Mtulize na upime tena baada ya dakika 30.
avoid: Usimpe dozi za ziada za dawa yake wala dawa ya mtu mwingine.
Usimwache afanye kazi nzito mpaka ikaguliwe.
sw.intro: Kipimo kimoja cha juu si dharura kila mara. Muhimu ni kiko juu kiasi gani na kama ana dalili.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 kama kipimo ni 180/120 au zaidi na ana maumivu ya kifua, maumivu makali ya kichwa, kukosa pumzi, kuchanganyikiwa, kuona ukungu, udhaifu au ganzi, au shida ya kuongea.
sw.after: Weka kumbukumbu ya vipimo umwonyeshe daktari wake.

title.sw: Shinikizo la damu liko juu sana

examples: his belly is swollen and hard
what to do for a bad tummy ache

steps: Help them into a comfortable position, often lying with knees bent.
Give small sips of water only.
Note where the pain is, when it started, whether it comes and goes, and any vomiting, diarrhoea, fever or urine problems.
Contact their doctor or clinic today if the pain lasts more than a few hours or keeps coming back.
avoid: Do not give food until a doctor has seen them if the pain is severe.
Do not give painkillers such as ibuprofen or aspirin, or laxatives, unless a doctor advises.
en.intro: Stomach pain has many causes. In older people serious problems can show few signs, so take strong or unusual pain seriously.
en.urgent: Call 999 or 112 if the pain is sudden and severe, they vomit blood or something like coffee grounds, pass black or bloody stools, the belly is hard and swollen, they faint, or the pain spreads to the chest.
en.after: Share your notes with the doctor and the family.

steps: Msaidie akae katika mkao mzuri, mara nyingi akiwa amelala na magoti yamekunjwa.
Mpe mafunda madogo ya maji tu.
Andika wapi panauma, yalianza lini, kama yanakuja na kwenda, na kama kuna kutapika, kuhara, homa au matatizo ya mkojo.
Wasiliana na daktari au kliniki yake leo kama maumivu yanadumu zaidi ya saa chache au yanarudi.
avoid: Usimpe chakula mpaka daktari amwone kama maumivu ni makali.
Usimpe dawa za maumivu kama ibuprofen au aspirini, wala dawa za kuharisha, isipokuwa daktari akishauri.
sw.intro: Maumivu ya tumbo yana sababu nyingi. Kwa wazee matatizo makubwa yanaweza kuonyesha dalili chache, kwa hiyo chukulia maumivu makali au yasiyo ya kawaida kwa uzito.
sw.urgent: Piga 999 au 112 kama maumivu ni ya ghafla na makali, anatapika damu au kitu kama mashapo ya kahawa, kinyesi ni cheusi au chenye damu, tumbo ni gumu na limevimba, anazirai, au maumivu yanaenea kifuani.
sw.after: Shiriki maelezo yako na daktari na familia.

examples: she has an itchy rash after a new medicine
mild allergic reaction what to do
ana vipele vinavyowasha baada ya dawa mpya

steps: Remove or stop the trigger if you know it, for example wash off a cream or move away from a plant.
An antihistamine tablet can help if they have taken it safely before.
A cool damp cloth on itchy skin can ease it.
Watch them closely for the next 1 to 2 hours for signs of a severe reaction.
avoid: Do not give the next dose of a medicine that may have caused it until a doctor advises.
en.intro: A mild allergy causes an itchy rash or hives, sneezing, a runny nose or itchy eyes, without breathing problems or swelling of the face or throat.
en.urgent: If they get swelling of the lips, tongue or throat, wheezing, difficulty breathing or feel faint, it is a severe reaction: call 999 or 112 and use their adrenaline injector if they have one.
en.after: Tell the family and the doctor, and write the new allergy on their medicine list.

steps: Ondoa au simamisha chanzo kama unakijua, kwa mfano osha krimu au ondoka karibu na mmea.
Kidonge cha mzio (antihistamine) kinaweza kusaidia kama amekitumia salama hapo awali.
Kitambaa baridi chenye unyevu kwenye ngozi inayowasha kinaweza kupunguza.
Mwangalie kwa karibu kwa saa 1 hadi 2 zinazofuata kwa dalili za mzio mkali.
avoid: Usimpe dozi inayofuata ya dawa inayoweza kuwa imesababisha mpaka daktari ashauri.
sw.intro: Mzio mdogo husababisha vipele vinavyowasha, kupiga chafya, mafua au macho kuwasha, bila matatizo ya kupumua wala uvimbe usoni au kooni.
sw.urgent: Akipata uvimbe wa midomo, ulimi au koo, mluzi, kupumua kwa shida au kuhisi kuzimia, ni mzio mkali: piga 999 au 112 na utumie sindano yake ya adrenaline kama anayo.
sw.after: Iambie familia na daktari, na uandike mzio huo mpya kwenye orodha ya dawa zake.

examples: she is having a panic attack
he is very anxious and breathing fast
how to calm someone having an anxiety attack
she is shaking and scared and can't calm down
jinsi ya kumtuliza mtu mwenye panic attack

steps: Move to a quiet place and stay with them.
Speak calmly and reassure them that it will pass.
Breathe slowly with them: in through the nose for 4 counts, out through the mouth for 6 counts.
Help them notice their surroundings, for example name 5 things they can see.
Stay until they feel calm.
avoid: Do not ask them to breathe into a paper bag.
Do not tell them to just calm down or that it is nothing.
en.intro: A panic attack causes a racing heart, fast breathing, shaking, sweating and intense fear. It feels frightening but passes, usually within 20 minutes.
en.urgent: In an older person, chest pain, breathlessness or feeling faint can be a heart problem. Unless they have had panic attacks before and this feels the same, treat it as a medical emergency and call 999 or 112.
en.after: If attacks keep happening, suggest they talk to their doctor.

steps: Nendeni mahali penye utulivu na ukae naye.
Ongea kwa utulivu na umhakikishie kwamba itapita.
Pumueni polepole pamoja: ndani kwa pua kwa hesabu 4, nje kwa mdomo kwa hesabu 6.
Msaidie aangalie mazingira yake, kwa mfano ataje vitu 5 anavyoviona.
Kaa naye mpaka atulie.
avoid: Usimwambie apumue ndani ya mfuko wa karatasi.
Usimwambie atulie tu au kwamba si kitu.
sw.intro: Hofu kali (panic attack) husababisha moyo kwenda mbio, kupumua haraka, kutetemeka, jasho na hofu kubwa. Inatisha lakini huisha, kwa kawaida ndani ya dakika 20.
sw.urgent: Kwa mzee, maumivu ya kifua, kukosa pumzi au kuhisi kuzimia kunaweza kuwa tatizo la moyo. Isipokuwa amewahi kupata hofu kali hapo awali na hii inafanana, ichukulie kama dharura na upige 999 au 112.
sw.after: Kama hofu kali zinaendelea kutokea, mshauri azungumze na daktari wake.

examples: she has a red patch on her bottom that won't go away
sore on his heel from lying in bed
pressure ulcer care for a bedridden patient
how often should i turn him in bed
ana kidonda makalioni kwa kulala sana
jinsi ya kuzuia vidonda vya kitanda

steps: Change their position at least every 2 hours in bed, and help them shift their weight every 15 to 30 minutes in a chair.
Use pillows between the knees and ankles, and keep the heels off the mattress with a pillow under the calves.
Keep the skin clean and dry, especially after incontinence, and apply moisturiser.
Lift rather than drag when moving them, to avoid rubbing the skin.
Encourage good food and plenty of fluids, which help the skin heal.
Tell the nurse or doctor about any broken skin, blister or new sore.

Do not use ring or doughnut cushions.

ORS sachets, paracetamol, and any emergency medicines they are prescribed, such as an inhaler or adrenaline injector.
